Combine and Append Multiple Single-Cell Benchmark Results

Source: R/10_visualizations.R
combine_benchmark_results.Rd

Harmonizes, standardizes, and consolidates multiple single-cell simulator evaluation datasets or saved benchmark sessions into a unified multi-dataset benchmark object.

Usage

combine_benchmark_results(
  ...,
  list_of_benchmarks = NULL,
  dataset_names = NULL,
  filter_gold_standard = TRUE,
  recompute_normalized = TRUE
)

append_benchmark_results(
  ...,
  list_of_benchmarks = NULL,
  dataset_names = NULL,
  filter_gold_standard = TRUE,
  recompute_normalized = TRUE
)

Arguments

...

One or more benchmark evaluation objects, tidy data frames, or file paths (ending in .rds or .csv).

list_of_benchmarks

Optional list of benchmark objects or data frames.

dataset_names

Optional character vector specifying custom names for each dataset being combined. If NULL, dataset names are automatically extracted from the input objects or generated cleanly (e.g., "Dataset 1", "Dataset 2").

filter_gold_standard

Logical. If TRUE (default), filters all combined datasets to the 48 Gold-Standard curated evaluation metrics.

recompute_normalized

Logical. If TRUE (default), re-normalizes raw metric scores across all evaluated simulators and datasets using direction-aware scaling.

Value

An S3 object of class c("scSimEval_multidataset_benchmark", "scSimEval_consolidated", "list") containing:

  • benchmark_summary_table: Tidy data frame of cross-dataset average fidelity scores per simulator and metric (ready for plot_benchmark_bubble_matrix).

  • granular_benchmark_table: Complete combined data frame preserving individual dataset rows.

  • dataset_summary_table: Summary table of all combined datasets and simulator counts.

  • dataset_summary_df: Alias of dataset_summary_table.

  • cross_dataset_stats: Data frame of mean, SD, SE, and sample count per simulator-metric pair.

  • methods: Unique simulator names evaluated across all datasets.

  • datasets: Vector of distinct dataset names.

  • is_multidataset: Logical indicating whether more than one dataset is included.

  • n_datasets: Integer number of datasets.

  • n_simulators: Integer number of unique simulators.

Details

When the same simulator (e.g., "scDesign3" or "scMultiSim") is evaluated across multiple empirical datasets, combine_benchmark_results maintains each distinct dataset evaluation and provides cross-dataset aggregate fidelity scores across the 48 Gold-Standard curated metrics. This enables rigorous comparative evaluation and bubble matrix visualization of average simulator performance across diverse biological contexts.

Examples

# \donttest{
data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
res1 <- evaluate_simulation_accuracy(example_scrna$ref, example_scrna$sim)
#> [1/5] Extracting cell-level properties...
#> [2/5] Extracting feature-level properties...
#> [3/5] Computing univariate accuracy metrics...
#> [4/5] Computing bivariate metrics (Fasano-Franceschini, Peacock, KDE zstat, 2D EMD)...
#> [5/5] Computing zero-probability and manifold distances...
#> [6/7] Evaluating trajectory and lineage dynamics...
#> Unimodal accuracy evaluation complete.
res2 <- evaluate_simulation_accuracy(example_scrna$ref, example_scrna$sim)
#> [1/5] Extracting cell-level properties...
#> [2/5] Extracting feature-level properties...
#> [3/5] Computing univariate accuracy metrics...
#> [4/5] Computing bivariate metrics (Fasano-Franceschini, Peacock, KDE zstat, 2D EMD)...
#> [5/5] Computing zero-probability and manifold distances...
#> [6/7] Evaluating trajectory and lineage dynamics...
#> Unimodal accuracy evaluation complete.
comb <- combine_benchmark_results(res1, res2, dataset_names = c("Cohort A", "Cohort B"))
#> Warning: Item 1 could not be parsed as a valid benchmark table; skipping.
#> Warning: Item 2 could not be parsed as a valid benchmark table; skipping.
#> Error in combine_benchmark_results(res1, res2, dataset_names = c("Cohort A",     "Cohort B")): None of the supplied inputs contained valid benchmark data.
print(comb$datasets)
#> Error: object 'comb' not found
# }
